evidence: Unlimited Bonus Farming: The calculate_sm_nft_bonus function is intended to reward users once when they opt into SM-NFT. However, due to its repeated application on every split, attackers can loop the merge-split process to continually receive unearned bonuses. This causes exponential inflation of locked balances from a fixed initial deposit (e.g., 100 tokens can become 200, 300, etc.).
report_impact_coverage.reason: All selected I-source rules were formalized.

However, due to its repeated application on every split, attackers can loop the merge-split process to continually receive unearned bonuses. This causes exponential inflation of locked balances from a fixed initial deposit (e.g., 100 tokens can become 200, 300, etc.).

evidence: An attacker can exploit this by repeatedly merging and splitting SM-NFTs—each time receiving additional bonus tokens that should only have been granted once. By looping this process, the attacker effectively farms unearned bonus tokens and inflates their locked balance far beyond their actual deposit, creating a major economic vulnerability in the system.
